source_row.rationale: Pneumococcal vaccination can help prevent infection with certain pneumococcal bacteria strains, an important preventive measure particularly emphasized for older adults and those with certain chronic conditions who are at increased risk for serious pneumococcal disease, though it does not guarantee prevention of all pneumonia types (such as viral pneumonia).
